WENT_WEREWOLF:
You circle from above. The wolf
spots you. Its tail starts wagging.

You dive. It leaps with pure joy.
It yelps. You win. It looks sad.

You advance. The wolf snarls...
then its tail starts wagging.

It trips over itself lunging.
You win. It wags the whole time.

You cast a calming aura.
The wolf goes very, very still.

It tilts its head. It whines.
Are those eyes of hope? Oh no.

It follows you. You shoo it.
Eventually you win, sort of.

It wags hopefully at you.
Still waiting for that stick.
WNPC_LITTLE_GIRL:
Air drop. Sound plan.
I mapped it earlier.

Crude. Effective.
I suppose that works.

Passable. I'd have
targeted the joints.
WBOSS_OGRE:
You dive. The Ogre's stew goes
flying. He stares in horror.

'My reduction! Three hours work!
You ANIMAL!' He charges.

You draw your sword. The Ogre
sniffs. 'Adventurer steak!'

He fights and complains about
your 'lack of marinade.'

You cast fire. The Ogre stops.
'That sear! Give me the recipe!'

He chases you for cooking tips.
You win. He's devastated.

He sulks over a cold cauldron.
'No one appreciates the craft.'
WNPC_OLD_MAN:
A dragon! Wait... er.
A friendly one? Hello.

Here. This... powder.
Probably safe. Thanks.

My hero! Here, take
this. It's, uh... hmm.

A wizard! Here —
a vial! Take it. Uh.

Potion of... uh...
I forget. Still good.
WENT_SILVER_KNIGHT:
'I challenge you to— you're
flying. That is not permitted.'

'Land immediately. Duelling
rules forbid airborne opponents.'

He refuses to engage. You wait
him out. He sulks. You pass.

He bows stiffly. 'I am
overqualified for guarding a door.'

'Top of my class. Three dragons
before breakfast. This is that.'

He fights brilliantly while
being furious about the posting.

'Magic?' He scoffs. 'A knight
fights with steel. Not tricks.'

Your spell hits him squarely.
He stands in dignified silence.

'I will not dignify that
with a reaction.' He falls.

He stands aside, impeccably.
Still visibly furious about it.
WNPC_KING:
'Mm? Oh yes, the demon thing.
Do deal with Gerald first.'

'Oh, you beat Gerald! Lovely.
Now. Look at this diorama.'

'Siege of Ashenvale, 1204.
Note the pauldron detail. Note it.'

'You may pass. I am also
bestowing: Diorama Appreciator.'

'Still here? Good. Have you
considered this composition?'
WENT_SKELETON:
The skeletons are mid-argument
about whose femur is whose.

You dart through while they
sort out the bone situation.

A skeleton lurches forward,
waving its sword arm menacingly.

Its other arm falls off.
'That's mine,' it says. It stops.

The fight pauses so it can
retrieve its limbs. You win.

You cast a light spell. The
skeleton stops. 'Is that Luminara?'

It leans in, asks questions.
You defeat it mid-lecture.

A single arm gives a thumbs up
from the corner. Not its arm.
WNPC_CARPENTER:
Out! Those rafters —
Could you hold one up?

Rescued! Good. Now,
can swords chip stone?

Free! Now — that crack.
Blast it. Just once.
WENT_GENIE:
'You are FLYING INDOORS,' the
Genie declares. 'Not permitted.'

'This requires Permit 22-C.
Do you have a Permit 22-C?'

You do not. The fight is now
officially about the permit.

You find a loophole. He is
deeply, professionally furious.

'Oh! A physical threat! Lovely!
I'll need you to file Form 7-B.'

No Form 7-B exists. You fight
him anyway. He seems relieved.

'All spells require advance
filing in triplicate. Page six.'

You cite Sub-Clause 9-C of
the Mystical Conduct Register.

The clause doesn't exist.
He checks anyway. You win.

He broods over his paperwork.
'Loopholes everywhere. Everywhere.'
WNPC_MOTHER:
I once flew injured.
In winter. Nobody saw.

I bled more last
Tuesday. Without help.

I gave birth in
a blizzard. Twice.
WENT_ORC:
The cave ceiling is very low.
You scramble. The Orc watches.

'You look uncomfortable. That
is valid data. Let's unpack it.'

You lose turns to an unwanted
pep talk. Then you win.

'GOOD.' The Orc cracks its
knuckles. 'Finally, a challenge.'

You trade brutal, honest blows.
The Orc respects every one.

Defeated, it nods. 'Good form.
Your left guard. Work on it.'

The Orc sees your staff.
'Ha! Little stick person! Ha!'

Your spell caves the ceiling.
Directly onto the Orc. Directly.

'I see,' it says, pinned.
'What were you FEELING there?'

It waves from the rubble.
'Outstanding session. Well done.'
WNPC_FATHER:
At that altitude?!
You could get a cold!

Promise me you'll
wear a warm scarf up.

Oh, thank goodness.
Did you stretch first?

Promise me you'll
be home before eight.

You're safe! Are
those spell burns bad?

Promise me you'll
wear a fireproof scarf.
WENT_TROLL:
'You will NOT land here without
a landing permit. Form 31-L.'

You hover. He protests. You
outlast him on a technicality.

The Troll raises a clipboard.
'This is a Heritage Zone. Stop.'

'Any combat causes structural
damage. Please file Form 18-T.'

You file nothing. You fight.
He annotates your every move.

Your first spell clips a column.
The Troll shrieks. 'IRREPLACEABLE.'

He documents the damage. You
walk past him. He doesn't notice.

He sits filing damage reports
in the rubble. Very thorough.
WENT_GHOST:
'BEHOLD, I AM THE—' You fly
through him at full speed.

You do it again. He sags.
'Three hundred years,' he says.

'Three hundred years of practice.
You flew through me. Twice.'

The Ghost begins his entrance.
Eerie winds. Flickering candles.

The wail. The cold. The reveal.
You stare at him. Blankly.

He stops. 'Nothing?' He checks
his notes. He is devastated.

The Ghost begins his routine.
You raise your staff. 'Fascinating.'

'The spectral resonance here
is a grade-three harmonic loop.'

He stops. Three centuries of
craft, peer-reviewed to death.

He hovers, dejected.
'I really thought the wail was good.'
WENT_DARK_KNIGHT:
'A Wyvern! Very niche, very
interesting brand. I love it.'

He tries to hand you a card.
You have no hands. He adapts.

He tucks it in a wing scale.
'Reach out. Big synergies here.'

'Fellow swordsman!' He bows.
A business card appears. Two cards.

'After we're done, I'd love
to connect. Big things ahead.'

He fights well. He hands you
another card mid-fight.

'A Mage! Excellent vertical for
my mage-adjacent network. Truly.'

He pauses mid-fight to ask
your specialty. You blast him.

'I'll follow up by raven.'
He falls, elegantly. Smiling.

A raven arrives. It drops a
card. 'Great connecting today!'
WBOSS_LAND_DRAGON:
From the air: a house-sized
dragon, lying very, very still.

You land. 'I don't see you,'
it says. 'I am a boulder. Leave.'

You point out it isn't a rock.
Its embarrassment is total.

A boulder blocks the pass.
You approach. It sighs deeply.

'I am a rock. This is a rock
area. You are seeing nothing.'

You fight the rock. The rock
sighs loudly and fights back.

A large boulder sits in your
path. You cast Reveal. It gasps.

'HOW DARE YOU. I was FINE.
I was a PERFECT boulder. Fine.'

It fights while refusing to
acknowledge it's a dragon.

'I am a geological feature.
You didn't see anything here.'
WBOSS_FIRE_DRAGON:
You land near the open kiln.
The dragon belches. Then winces.

'YOU! Your landing shook me!
Now my heartburn's a full episode!'

'I had calcium! I was FINE!
FIGHT ME. I need to lie down.'

The dragon is mid-glassblowing.
It ignores you completely.

'ONE MOMENT. The neck on this
vase is very, very delicate.'

You interrupt. The vase shatters.
The dragon is not okay.

You cast a fire bolt. It hits
the dragon's work-in-progress.

The dragon turns very slowly.
'That was an art piece. Mine.'

'My fire is nuanced. Yours was
just arson. I am appalled.'

'That piece could have been
beautiful. It was almost done.'
WBOSS_WIND_DRAGON:
A sky fight at last! The dragon
zooms past trailing rumours.

'That Wyvern gone rogue? Is
that YOU? Are you that Wyvern?!'

It stops to gossip about you.
You use the opening. You win.

'Oh! Did you hear? The Demon
Lord keeps a POTTERY DIARY!'

You ignore this. You advance.
The dragon is genuinely shocked.

It keeps talking. You keep
fighting. You win mid-sentence.

'Oh! A Mage! I heard something
about you. Something JUICY.'

You pause. '...What?' It grins.
'Trade you. Info for info.'

You trade. You learn his one
weakness. Worth every secret.

'Fine. But if you hear anything
new— anything— you tell me.'
WBOSS_PUMPKIN_HEAD:
'YOU! HALT! I'm serving—' You
fly away. The voice echoes after.

'COME BACK. Form 4-P, cease
and desist ALL aerial evasion—'

You are gone. The subpoena
lands in the swamp. Case closed.

A hollow voice booms: 'HALT!
You are hereby served notice—'

'—unauthorized use of likeness
in all commerce. Sign here.'

You cut through the preamble.
And then through him.

'Before we begin, I must ask:
did you purchase Pumpkin Spice?'

You pause. Your breakfast was
a pumpkin spice latte. Oh no.

The deposition takes three turns.
You win on a technicality.

'This isn't over! My clerk has
filed a mystical appeal!'
WDEMONLORD:
You dive at the Demon Lord.
He flinches. 'YOU! Flying youth!'

'No respect. No gravitas at all.
Just zooming. Entitled zooming.'

He monologues about youth. You
use the opening. You press on.

'Oh. A swordsman. Let me guess:
prophecy? Chosen one? The sword?'

'Eleven heroes this century.
Same entrance. Same pose. Same.'

You fight. He sighs the whole
time. His back gives out. You win.

You begin disrupting the ritual.
The Demon Lord winces. 'My back.'

'Of all the days. I have a
warded disc. Do you MIND?'

You press on. He fights through
lower back spasms. You win.

'I yield. The pottery shop will
be better than this. It will.'
